=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:348-360 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: When a `+=` assignment is parsed, the code strips the `+` suffix and correctly sets `working_directory = None` for `GIT_DIR` / `GIT_WORK_TREE`, but then falls through to the next `if` (not `elif`) and still executes `environment[name] = value`. For `GIT_DIR+=/path` this stores `environment["GIT_DIR"] = "/path"` — the raw RHS, not the appended result.
  WHY: The invocation is built with `cwd = checkout` (because `working_directory` is `None`) but `environment = {"GIT_DIR": "/path"}`. In the new `destination == "HEAD"` branch at lines 489-492 the guard calls `current_branch(invocation.cwd)` inside `_git_environment(invocation.environment)`, which exports `GIT_DIR=/path` before running `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`. If `/path` happens to be a valid git directory the command resolves the branch of that repository instead of the session checkout, and the merged-PR guard checks the wrong branch. If `/path` is not a git directory the call fails and `current_branch` returns `""`, silently skipping the refspec — still not the "treat as unknown, check the session checkout" behaviour the comment and the `working_directory = None` assignment intend. The fix is `elif name in ("GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE"):` (or an `else` on the append branch) so `environment` is not populated for `+=` assignments whose final value depends on shell state.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
